text: Program Introduction: This major requires students to understand and familiarity with the basic theories and basic knowledge of international economic trade and international finance on the basis of systematic study and mastery of English professional skills and English professional knowledge. They are required to receive basic training in economics and management, with modern management awareness and strategic vision. The real English language foundation is related to the theoretical analysis and practical skills of related disciplines. Through the study and training of this major, it has good political and ideological quality, and can directly use English to engage in international trade's foreign ability and adaptability, understand the necessary economic theory, and be familiar with the export-oriented and compound talents of international business application norms and procedures. Future Career: Foreign investment and Sino foreign joint ventures, foreign trade enterprises, financial institutions and scientific research and teaching units, government institutions and foreign consulates and cultural institutions in China are engaged in international trade, translation, management, consultation and teaching, and can also go abroad for further study and study for master's graduate students. Duration: 4years Fees Tuition Fee: 26,000 CNY/Yr. Accommodation: Two room apartment with a bathroom and kitchen: 1,300 CNT/Mth. per room Shared bed-room with a bathroom: 550 CNY/Mth.per bed Single room with bathroom: 1,100 CNY/Mth. per room * Electric and water costs are not included.
